rationale: Features: every catalogue option that is legitimately available at prediction time; excluded claim_id, member_id and rendering_npi (identifiers) and fraud_pattern_type (null on 12198 of 12845 rows, i.e. populated only for labelled fraud, so label-derived). Included drg_present as the inpatient indicator and high_cost_flag, which derives from amounts, not the label. Split: test_size 0.25 (a quarter held out), stratify true so prevalence_train and prevalence_test are reported and match; the run seed is applied by the component. Preprocessing: fit_on train_only to prevent leakage; standard scaling because logistic regression is scale-sensitive and the scaler is also fitted on train only. Models: logistic_regression plus random_forest as the one tree-based model; class_weight balanced because the label is roughly 647 / 12845 = 5% positive, so an unweighted fit at the fixed 0.5 threshold would yield a near-empty positive prediction row in the confusion matrix. Report: exactly the four required limitations (synthetic label, class imbalance, baseline model, no operational use), denominators printed for every rate including the partition prevalences, and every result cited to model_metrics.json, feature_list.json or the split keys.
